title: GRU Projected Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Sequence Layers/GRU_Projected_Layer.md
text: Gated recurrent unit (GRU) projected layer for recurrent neural network (RNN), 1 input, 1 output, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Layer} sets the corresponding layer object, {Data format} sets the format of input, {Stateful prediction} sets the whether to use stateful prediction, {Activation approximation method} sets the approximation method for computing activation function, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Input weights} sets the data type of input weights, {Recurrent weights} sets the data type of recurrent weights, {Bias} sets the data type of bias, {Input projector weights} sets the data type of input projector weights, {Output projector weights} sets the data type of output projector weights, {Initial hidden state} sets the data type of initial hidden state, {Hidden state} sets the data type of hidden state, {Input weights matrix multiply output} sets the data type of input weights matrix multiply output, {Recurrent weights matrix multiply output} sets the data type of recurrent weights matrix multiply output, {Input projector weights matrix multiply output} sets the data type of input projector weights matrix multiply output, {Output projector weights matrix multiply output} sets the data type of output projector weights matrix multiply output and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.
